subject: general
question:
Find the value of the expression

[cosec(75° + θ) – sec(15° – θ) – tan(55° + θ) + cot(35° – θ)]
solution:
**Given**

[cosec(75° + θ) – sec(15° – θ) – tan(55° + θ) + cot(35° – θ)]

**Formula used**

sec(90° - θ) = cosecθ 

cot(90° - θ) = tanθ 

**Calculation**

[cosec(75° + θ) – sec(15° – θ) – tan(55° + θ) + cot(35° – θ)]

⇒ [cosec(75° + θ) - sec[90° - (75 + θ)] - tan(55° + θ) + cot[90° - (55° + θ)]

⇒ cosec(75° + θ) - cosec(75° + θ) - tan(55° + θ) + tan(55° + θ)

⇒ 0

**∴ The value of [cosec(75° + θ) – sec(15° – θ) – tan(55° + θ) + cot(35° – θ)] is 0.**
